title: "Recent Files" in Application Launcher and KRunner contain entries, that no longer exist, and is slow to pick up new entries.
line: KRunner no longer offers recent files that have since been renamed or deleted.
explanation: The Recent Files runner keeps one activity-stats ResultModel and reuses it for every query that starts with the previous one, even across KRunner sessions. The stats library only checks for missing files when the model loads, so after a rename or delete the reused model kept the old path and KRunner offered a file that no longer exists (opening it fails). The runner now skips results whose local file doesn't exist; the query is already limited to local paths.

commits.message:
runners/recentdocuments: skip files that no longer exist

The runner keeps its activity stats model across queries, so a file that
was renamed or deleted after it was opened kept being offered under Recent
Files and failed to open. Skip results whose file no longer exists.

BUG: 506792

media.caption: Master: after renaming very-specific-filename.txt to very-specific-filename-changed.txt, KRunner still offers the old, non-existent name under Recent Files
With the fix, same steps: only the existing renamed file is shown (via Documents), no stale Recent Files entry

review.text: Filtering non-existent paths in RecentDocuments::match() stops KRunner from showing stale entries in the reused-model scenario, but it does not completely fix the reported bug or address the right layer. The bug is filed against Application Launcher (Kickoff) and KRunner (including phantom entries surviving reboot in comment #3), yet Kickoff's Recent Files list was neither tested nor fixed, and claiming plasma-activities-stats already drops missing files on load does not cover Kickoff's long-lived model in plasmashell or post-reboot phantom entries. Filtering only after Limit(m_maxResults) also lets deleted files consume result slots, and RecentDocuments still retains a stale ResultModel across KRunner sessions.
changes: Fix stale non-existent local file entries at the shared plasma-activities-stats / kactivitymanagerd layer (or verify and fix both Application Launcher's Recent Files view and KRunner) so both surfaces drop missing files and deleted entries do not consume Limit(m_maxResults) slots.
In runners/recentdocuments/recentdocuments.cpp, reset m_resultsModel on teardown() (or refresh appropriately) rather than keeping a stale ResultModel across KRunner sessions.
Verify both Application Launcher's Recent Files list and KRunner (including with fresh queries / after restart, not just repeating the same query prefix).

reviews.text: The stale-entry half is fixed correctly and minimally. The runner reuses its ResultModel across queries, and the new QFileInfo::exists check drops renamed or deleted files; the before/after KRunner shots prove it. But the bug has two halves: the title and c0's 'MISSING ENTRIES' section also say Recent Files is slow to pick up new entries, and a renamed file's new name never appears until it is reopened. The notes say outright that this part is not addressed, yet the commit uses BUG: 506792, so the report would be closed with half of it still open.
changes: Either also make renames show up under the new name, e.g. have kactivitymanagerd follow KDirNotify FileRenamed/FileRenamedWithLocalPath (emitted by Dolphin/KIO renames) and update the stored resource path, so the renamed file appears in Recent Files without reopening it; or change the trailer to CCBUG: 506792 so the bug stays open for the missing-entries half.
Mention in the commit message that only the stale-entry half is handled if it stays CCBUG.
